game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the caravan guide must hold off sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Test Gauntlet: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: In Mirage Road, repeat each round: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones. Then check tests and advance.
player_objective: Protect the bazaar gate from sand wyrms in Mirage Road: keep tests above zero until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Test Gauntlet
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 5, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

learning_objectives: Understand the idea behind: Debugging & Combined Skills
Apply “Test Gauntlet” in a short challenge
Predict what the code does before running it
Notice and fix a mistake in the code

ui.title: Mirage Road: Test Gauntlet
ui.subtitle: Hold out until the timer ends!

hint: Read the code panel: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones. Keep tests above zero until the timer reaches 34.

tutorial.message: Sand wyrms are coming! Watch the tests meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: assert f(2) == 4
Survive for 34 seconds to complete the level.

on_win.title: Level Cleared!
on_win.message: You mastered Test Gauntlet in Sand Dunes!

on_lose.title: Try Again!
on_lose.message: tests ran out. Fix the code sooner and watch the meter!
